drivingQuestion: To which clause of the baraita does the parallel ruling about a Torah scroll refer?
outcomeNote: The floated reading is rejected and the latter clause is settled on.

segments.he: תָּנוּ רַבָּנַן: הַמּוֹלִיךְ עֲצָמוֹת מִמָּקוֹם לְמָקוֹם, הֲרֵי זֶה לֹא יִתְּנֵם בְּדִסַקַּיָּא וְיִתְּנֵם עַל גַּבֵּי חֲמוֹר וְיִרְכַּב עֲלֵיהֶם, מִפְּנֵי שֶׁנּוֹהֵג בָּהֶם מִנְהַג בִּזָּיוֹן. וְאִם הָיָה מִתְיָרֵא מִפְּנֵי גּוֹיִם וּמִפְּנֵי לִסְטִים — מוּתָּר. וּכְדֶרֶךְ שֶׁאָמְרוּ בַּעֲצָמוֹת כָּךְ אָמְרוּ בְּסֵפֶר תּוֹרָה.
segments.en: The Gemara discusses other issues concerning the dignity of the deceased. «The Sages taught: One who transports bones from place to place may not place them in a saddlebag [disakaya] and place them on the donkey’s back and ride on them, as» in doing so «he treats» the remains «disgracefully. However, if he is afraid of gentiles» or «highwaymen» and therefore must move quickly, «he is permitted» to do so. «And just as they said with regard to bones, so they said with regard to a Torah scroll.»

segments.he: אַהֵיָיא? אִילֵּימָא אַרֵישָׁא — פְּשִׁיטָא! מִי גָּרַע סֵפֶר תּוֹרָה מֵעֲצָמוֹת? אֶלָּא אַסֵּיפָא.
segments.en: With regard to this last statement, the Gemara asks: «To what» section of the baraita does the parallel to a Torah scroll refer? «If you say» that this refers to «the first clause» of the baraita, this is «obvious. Is a Torah scroll less» important «than bones» of the dead? Certainly one may not treat a Torah disgracefully. Rather, this statement must refer «to the latter clause» of the baraita, that in a dangerous situation, one is permitted to ride on a Torah scroll as well.

moves.summary: a baraita on carrying bones with dignity, and the same rule for a Torah scroll
moves.about: a baraita on one who transports bones and may not ride on them, and the same for a Torah scroll

moves.summary: a candidate: it attaches to the opening clause forbidding disgrace
moves.about: the floated reading that the addendum attaches to the baraita's opening clause is knocked down

moves.cueHe: פשיטא! מי גרע ספר תורה מעצמות?
moves.summary: that candidate is swatted: on it the addendum would say nothing
moves.about: attaching the addendum to the first clause would make it superfluous, since a Torah scroll is surely no less than bones

moves.summary: the addendum attaches to the latter clause, the leave granted in danger
moves.about: the addendum must attach to the latter clause: in danger one may ride even on a Torah scroll
